steps.caption: Agency workspace
steps.narration: An agency can queue one post for many client locations at once. This is the Agency page.

steps.caption: Every client location
steps.narration: Every client location is listed here.

steps.caption: Client and link status
steps.narration: Each one shows its client and whether it is linked to Google.

steps.caption: Tick a location
steps.narration: Tick the locations the post is for.

steps.caption: Tick another
steps.narration: Or choose Select all matching to take every location that fits the filter.

steps.caption: Schedule post/photo batch
steps.narration: Under Apply to selected locations, choose Schedule post/photo batch.

steps.caption: Content kind
steps.narration: Content kind is Post or Photo batch.

steps.value: Fall gutter clean-out slots are open. Call to book a free inspection.
steps.caption: Approved content
steps.narration: Type the text. It stays a draft until you queue it.

steps.caption: Media photo IDs
steps.narration: Media photo IDs attaches library photos by their number, if the batch has photos.

steps.caption: Queueing is the approval
steps.narration: Queueing approves this content for every selected location, through the same queue and daily budget.

steps.caption: Batch start time
steps.narration: Batch start time is when the first item publishes.

steps.caption: One job per location
steps.narration: Each location gets its own job, with progress and failures under Jobs.

steps.caption: Google Business → Agency
steps.narration: Agency is in the Google Business rail on the left.

youtube.title: How to queue a Google post for many client locations | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How an agency queues one post or photo batch across many client locations in ConstructHUB: tick the locations on the Agency page, choose Schedule post/photo batch, type the approved content and a start time, and queue it. Each location gets its own job in its own Posts & Photos queue.
